(4) The scene shifts to the person holding a cup of 'Shuang Xiang Pao' instant noodles on a small white plate, using wooden chopsticks to eat the noodles enthusiastically. The background is a grey wall next to the dark door. (5) The person is seen in an office setting with computer monitors, office chairs, and cubicle partitions. (6) A dynamic montage appears with the person eating noodles superimposed over vibrant, colorful backgrounds including orange flowers, yellow lilies, butterflies, and scenic landscapes like a forest river with cherry blossom borders. (7) The person returns to the door background, holding the noodle cup, giving a thumbs up and winking at the camera before a final piece of paper with the number '4' is swiped across the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice shouts the number '4' in Chinese with high intensity. The audio is dry with no background music. (2) Rapid-fire vocal delivery of various two-character words ending in 'Shi' follows, matching the rhythm of the visual cuts. Sharp vocal transients are clearly audible. (3) A sudden vocalized crying sound ('Wah!') marks a comedic beat, followed by a low-muttered vocalization ('Wangci') indicating a mistake. (4) A loud, sharp exclamation of 'Kaoshi!' and 'Youhangwushi!' with significant vocal projection. Sound of paper rustling as a strip is pulled. (5) Loud slurping sounds of someone eating noodles dominate the center channel, accompanied by satisfied vocal grunts. (6) A second female voice enters with a moderate volume conversational tone asking 'Ni zai ganma?'. The main speaker responds with an explosive, high-arousal shout 'Chi Shuang Xiang Pao!'. (7) High-tempo, comedic background music featuring traditional Chinese percussion and Suona woodwinds kicks in, creating a festive and frantic atmosphere during the eating montage. (8) The video concludes with a fast-paced slogan delivery and a final paper swipe sound effect, ending with a bright synthesized chime.
